findings.correction: Capture and validate every invoked recovery/validation boundary and its object identity, especially the native cell recovery path, before and after callbacks and before publication. Add per-family first/second RHS and final-callback substitution regressions with accepted-prefix rollback and replay checks. Do not change recovery equations.
findings.detail: The captured dispatch includes native operator guard/evaluate but not native.operator.cell.recover. In the frozen M_Q4 two-RHS problem, on_prepare replaced cell.recover after the first RHS was prepared. The second RHS's native strains and resultants were doubled. All owner guards passed, solve returned successfully and the checkpoint changed; independently reconstructing a fresh graph then rejected that checkpoint during exact replay.
findings.title: Native recovery dispatch can change during preparation without detection

findings.correction: Freeze exact family-specific result/internal/recovery schemas and validate keys, dimensions, numeric types, finite values and bounded counts for the whole journal before owner construction or replay. Cover missing/extra and malformed nested fields.
findings.detail: Restore validates each result only as a dict. Removing the required u field from a valid stored result and supplying the new digest caused one replay solve before rejection. No restored owner escaped; this is late validation, not demonstrated external accepted-state corruption.
findings.title: Malformed result snapshots reach replay before schema rejection
